```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(rdflib)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(fs)
library(htmltools)

data_dir        <- "data"
annotations_dir <- "annotations"
output_dir      <- "generated"
dir_create(output_dir)
dir_create(annotations_dir)

# Metrology area codes -> ABox file names (data/<code>.ttl)
areas <- c("AUV", "EM", "L", "M", "PR", "RI", "T", "TF")
names(areas) <- areas

area_scheme <- c(
  AUV = "generic", EM = "generic", L = "generic", M = "generic",
  PR = "generic", RI = "section", T = "generic", TF = "generic"
)

# Consultative Committee acronym used as each tab's label.
area_cc_label <- c(
  AUV = "CCAUV", EM = "CCEM", L = "CCL", M = "CCM",
  PR = "CCPR", RI = "CCRI", T = "CCT", TF = "CCTF"
)

notation_sort_key <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return("")
    nums <- regmatches(s, gregexpr("[0-9]+", s))[[1]]
    if (length(nums) == 0) return("")
    paste(sprintf("%08d", as.integer(nums)), collapse = ".")
  }, character(1))
}
```

```{r queries}
#| include: false

# NOTE: every query below is a trivial, mandatory single- or two-triple pattern with NO SPARQL OPTIONAL keyword anywhere.

qp <- function(x) paste0(
  "PREFIX sc:   <https://si-digital-framework.org/kcdb-sc#>\n",
  "PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>\n",
  "PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n", x
)

sparql_universe   <- qp("SELECT ?sc WHERE { ?sc a sc:ServiceCategory }")
sparql_notation   <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?notation WHERE { ?sc skos:notation ?notation }")
sparql_label      <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?label WHERE { ?sc rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(lang(?label) = 'en') }")
sparql_status     <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?statusURI WHERE { ?sc sc:hasStatus ?statusURI }")

sparql_subservice        <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?subservice WHERE { ?sc sc:isIndividualServiceOf ?subservice }")
sparql_subservice_label  <- qp("SELECT ?subservice ?subserviceLabel WHERE { ?subservice rdfs:label ?subserviceLabel . FILTER(lang(?subserviceLabel) = 'en') }")
sparql_service            <- qp("SELECT ?subservice ?service WHERE { ?subservice sc:isSubserviceOf ?service }")
sparql_service_label      <- qp("SELECT ?service ?serviceLabel WHERE { ?service rdfs:label ?serviceLabel . FILTER(lang(?serviceLabel) = 'en') }")
sparql_branch             <- qp("SELECT ?service ?branch WHERE { ?service sc:isServiceOf ?branch }")
sparql_branch_label       <- qp("SELECT ?branch ?branchLabel WHERE { ?branch rdfs:label ?branchLabel . FILTER(lang(?branchLabel) = 'en') }")

sparql_section       <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?section WHERE { ?sc sc:hasSection ?section }")
sparql_section_label <- qp("SELECT ?section ?sectionLabel WHERE { ?section rdfs:label ?sectionLabel . FILTER(lang(?sectionLabel) = 'en') }")
sparql_medium        <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?medium WHERE { ?sc sc:hasMedium ?medium }")
sparql_medium_label  <- qp("SELECT ?medium ?mediumLabel WHERE { ?medium rdfs:label ?mediumLabel . FILTER(lang(?mediumLabel) = 'en') }")
sparql_source        <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?source WHERE { ?sc sc:hasSource ?source }")
sparql_source_label  <- qp("SELECT ?source ?sourceLabel WHERE { ?source rdfs:label ?sourceLabel . FILTER(lang(?sourceLabel) = 'en') }")
sparql_qaxis         <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?qaxis WHERE { ?sc sc:hasQuantity ?qaxis }")
sparql_qaxis_label   <- qp("SELECT ?qaxis ?quantityAxisLabel WHERE { ?qaxis rdfs:label ?quantityAxisLabel . FILTER(lang(?quantityAxisLabel) = 'en') }")

# Also mandatory/atomic -- a service category can have several, so this
# stays long-format rather than being folded into the joins above.
sparql_qty <- qp("SELECT ?sc ?quantity WHERE { ?sc sc:relatedSIQuantity ?quantity }")
```

```{r quantities-units}
#| include: false

# Parses reference/quantities.ttl once and builds a resolver that turns a
# relatedSIQuantity code (e.g. "DENS", or a composite like "MASS.TIME-1") into
# a formatted unit string (e.g. "kg\u00b7m\u207b\u00b3"), "1" for a genuinely
# dimensionless quantity, or NA if the code isn't in the graph at all.
#
# si:hasUnit is either a direct units:<name> resource, or a blank-node tree of
# si:UnitProduct (left * right) / si:UnitPower (base ^ exponent) nodes. This is
# resolved recursively into a flat list of (symbol, exponent) pairs so exponents
# compose correctly even when a composite code raises an already-compound unit
# to a further power (e.g. "EMIR.AREA-1" must give m\u207b\u00b2, not (m\u00b2)\u207b\u00b9 mis-rendered as m\u00b2\u207b\u00b9).

rdf_q <- rdf_parse(path("reference", "quantities.ttl"), format = "turtle")
triples <- rdf_query(rdf_q, "SELECT * WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }")

RDF_TYPE <- "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type"
SI    <- "https://si-digital-framework.org/SI#"
QBASE <- "https://si-digital-framework.org/quantities/"

# symbol_map <- c(
#   ampere = "A", becquerel = "Bq", bel = "B", candela = "cd", coulomb = "C",
#   degreeCelsius = "\u00b0C", farad = "F", gray = "Gy", henry = "H", hertz = "Hz",
#   joule = "J", katal = "kat", kelvin = "K", kilogram = "kg", lumen = "lm",
#   lux = "lx", metre = "m", mole = "mol", neper = "Np", newton = "N",
#   ohm = "\u03a9", pascal = "Pa", radian = "rad", second = "s", siemens = "S",
#   sievert = "Sv", steradian = "sr", tesla = "T", volt = "V", watt = "W", weber = "Wb"
# )
rdf_units <- rdf_parse(path("reference", "units.ttl"), format = "turtle")
symbol_rows <- rdf_query(rdf_units, "
  PREFIX si: <https://si-digital-framework.org/SI#>
  SELECT ?u ?symbol WHERE { ?u si:hasSymbol ?symbol }
")
symbol_map <- setNames(symbol_rows$symbol, sub(".*/", "", symbol_rows$u))

sup_map <- c(
  "0" = "\u2070", "1" = "\u00b9", "2" = "\u00b2", "3" = "\u00b3", "4" = "\u2074",
  "5" = "\u2075", "6" = "\u2076", "7" = "\u2077", "8" = "\u2078", "9" = "\u2079",
  "-" = "\u207b"
)
to_sup <- function(n) paste0(sup_map[strsplit(as.character(n), "")[[1]]], collapse = "")

empty_pairs <- function() tibble(sym = character(0), exp = numeric(0))
scale_pairs <- function(pairs, k) { if (nrow(pairs) > 0) pairs$exp <- pairs$exp * k; pairs }

# Recursively render one si:hasUnit node (a URI leaf or a blank-node tree)
# into a tibble of (symbol, exponent) pairs.
render_unit_node <- function(node) {
  if (is.na(node)) return(empty_pairs())
  if (grepl("^https?://", node)) {
    local <- sub(".*/", "", sub("/$", "", node))
    sym <- unname(symbol_map[local])
    if (is.na(sym)) sym <- local
    return(tibble(sym = sym, exp = 1))
  }
  props <- triples[triples$s == node, ]
  type_row <- props$o[props$p == RDF_TYPE]
  if (length(type_row) == 0) return(empty_pairs())
  type <- sub(".*[#/]", "", type_row[1])
  if (type == "UnitPower") {
    base <- props$o[props$p == paste0(SI, "hasUnitBase")][1]
    exponent <- as.numeric(props$o[props$p == paste0(SI, "hasNumericExponent")][1])
    return(scale_pairs(render_unit_node(base), exponent))
  }
  if (type == "UnitProduct") {
    left  <- props$o[props$p == paste0(SI, "hasLeftUnitTerm")][1]
    right <- props$o[props$p == paste0(SI, "hasRightUnitTerm")][1]
    return(bind_rows(render_unit_node(left), render_unit_node(right)))
  }
  empty_pairs()
}

# Direct lookup: quantity code -> pairs. An entry that exists but has no
# si:hasUnit (a dimensionless quantity like RHUM, REFI) is stored as an empty
# tibble, distinct from a code that has no entry at all (NULL on lookup).
quantity_rows <- triples %>%
  filter(p == RDF_TYPE, o == paste0(SI, "QuantityKind"), grepl(paste0("^", QBASE), s))

direct_unit_pairs <- list()
for (s_uri in quantity_rows$s) {
  code <- sub(paste0("^", QBASE), "", s_uri)
  unit_node <- triples$o[triples$s == s_uri & triples$p == paste0(SI, "hasUnit")]
  direct_unit_pairs[[code]] <- if (length(unit_node) == 0) empty_pairs() else render_unit_node(unit_node[1])
}

# A composite relatedSIQuantity code like "MASS.TIME-1" or "PRES.VOLU.TIME-1"
# is a dot-separated product of base codes, each optionally suffixed "-N" for
# a negative exponent N (no genuine base code in this graph contains a
# hyphen, confirmed, so this parsing is unambiguous).
token_re <- "^([A-Za-z]+)(-([0-9]+))?$"

resolve_quantity_code <- function(code, depth = 0) {
  if (!is.null(direct_unit_pairs[[code]])) return(direct_unit_pairs[[code]])
  if (depth > 5) return(NULL)
  parts <- strsplit(code, ".", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  out <- empty_pairs()
  for (part in parts) {
    m <- regmatches(part, regexec(token_re, part))[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 0) return(NULL)
    base_code <- m[2]
    k <- if (nzchar(m[4])) -as.numeric(m[4]) else 1
    base_pairs <- resolve_quantity_code(base_code, depth + 1)
    if (is.null(base_pairs)) return(NULL)
    out <- bind_rows(out, scale_pairs(base_pairs, k))
  }
  out
}

format_pairs <- function(pairs) {
  if (is.null(pairs)) return(NA_character_)
  if (nrow(pairs) == 0) return("1")
  paste0(
    map2_chr(pairs$sym, pairs$exp, function(sym, e) if (e == 1) sym else paste0(sym, to_sup(e))),
    collapse = "\u00b7"
  )
}

# Public entry point used by parse_area(): code -> formatted unit string, "1"
# (dimensionless), or NA (code not present in quantities.ttl at all).
unit_lookup <- function(code) format_pairs(resolve_quantity_code(code))

# Spelled-out quantity names (e.g. "density"), resolved the same way as
# units above: a direct dictionary from quantities.ttl's skos:prefLabel@en
# for atomic codes, recursively combined for composite codes like
# "MASS.TIME-1". This deliberately mirrors the symbolic unit notation
# (word\u00b7word\u207b\u00b9) rather than attempting idiomatic English phrasing
# ("mass per time") -- composing that kind of natural-language "per"
# scoping correctly is exactly the open metrological-linguistics question,
# so a literal symbolic join avoids silently taking a stance on it. Treat
# these as a starting point to hand-adjust, not a finished gloss.
sparql_quantity_pref_label <- "
PREFIX si:   <https://si-digital-framework.org/SI#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
SELECT ?q ?label WHERE { ?q a si:QuantityKind ; skos:prefLabel ?label . FILTER(lang(?label) = 'en') }
"
pref_label_rows <- rdf_query(rdf_q, sparql_quantity_pref_label)

direct_name_pairs <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pref_label_rows))) {
  code <- sub(paste0("^", QBASE), "", pref_label_rows$q[i])
  direct_name_pairs[[code]] <- tibble(sym = pref_label_rows$label[i], exp = 1)
}

resolve_quantity_name <- function(code, depth = 0) {
  if (!is.null(direct_name_pairs[[code]])) return(direct_name_pairs[[code]])
  if (depth > 5) return(NULL)
  parts <- strsplit(code, ".", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  out <- empty_pairs()
  for (part in parts) {
    m <- regmatches(part, regexec(token_re, part))[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 0) return(NULL)
    base_code <- m[2]
    k <- if (nzchar(m[4])) -as.numeric(m[4]) else 1
    base_pairs <- resolve_quantity_name(base_code, depth + 1)
    if (is.null(base_pairs)) return(NULL)
    out <- bind_rows(out, scale_pairs(base_pairs, k))
  }
  out
}

format_name_pairs <- function(pairs) {
  if (is.null(pairs) || nrow(pairs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  terms <- map2_chr(pairs$sym, pairs$exp, function(nm, e) if (e == 1) nm else paste0(nm, to_sup(e)))
  # Only parenthesise when there's an actual join to disambiguate -- a
  # single atomic name (e.g. "density") stays plain.
  if (length(terms) > 1) terms <- paste0("(", terms, ")")
  paste0(terms, collapse = "\u00b7")
}

quantity_name_lookup <- function(code) format_name_pairs(resolve_quantity_name(code))
```

```{r safe-query-helper}
#| include: false

# A query that legitimately matches nothing (e.g. sparql_section for a
# non-RI area, which has no sc:hasSection triples at all) can come back from
# rdf_query() as a bare 0-row/0-column data frame rather than a 0-row frame
# with the expected variable names -- which then breaks a downstream
# left_join() that expects those column names to exist. This wrapper
# guarantees the expected columns are always present, even when empty.
safe_query <- function(rdf, query, cols) {
  res <- rdf_query(rdf, query)
  if (nrow(res) == 0 || !all(cols %in% names(res))) {
    res <- as_tibble(setNames(replicate(length(cols), character(0), simplify = FALSE), cols))
  }
  res
}
```

```{r parse-function}
#| include: false

# Parses one metrology-area ABox file and returns a single merged table (plus
# a human-readable title): one row per (service category, related SI
# quantity) pair. Writes the fully-derived data to
# generated/<code>_service_categories.csv (always overwritten) and
# re-attaches any confirmation_status / comment from
# annotations/<code>_annotations.csv, keyed by mapping_id -- that file is
# only ever written once, the first time it doesn't exist; never overwritten.
parse_area <- function(code) {

  ttl_path <- path(data_dir, paste0(code, ".ttl"))
  rdf <- rdf_parse(ttl_path, format = "turtle")

  title <- tryCatch({
    sparql_title <- paste0(
      "PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>\n",
      "SELECT ?title WHERE { <https://si-digital-framework.org/kcdb-sc/", code, "> dcterms:title ?title }"
    )
    t <- rdf_query(rdf, sparql_title)
    if (nrow(t) > 0) t$title[1] else code
  }, error = function(e) code)

  # Build the wide table entirely via R-side left_join()s on atomic,
  # OPTIONAL-free query results -- see the note in the `queries` chunk.
  # safe_query() guards every call since several of these legitimately match
  # zero rows for a given area (e.g. no Section/Medium/Source/Quantity-axis
  # triples at all in the non-RI files).
  universe <- safe_query(rdf, sparql_universe, "sc")

  main_raw <- universe %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_notation, c("sc", "notation")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_label,    c("sc", "label")),    by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_status,   c("sc", "statusURI")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_subservice, c("sc", "subservice")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_subservice_label, c("subservice", "subserviceLabel")), by = "subservice") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_service, c("subservice", "service")), by = "subservice") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_service_label, c("service", "serviceLabel")), by = "service") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_branch, c("service", "branch")), by = "service") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_branch_label, c("branch", "branchLabel")), by = "branch") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_section, c("sc", "section")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_section_label, c("section", "sectionLabel")), by = "section") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_medium, c("sc", "medium")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_medium_label, c("medium", "mediumLabel")), by = "medium") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_source, c("sc", "source")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_source_label, c("source", "sourceLabel")), by = "source") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_qaxis, c("sc", "qaxis")), by = "sc") %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_qaxis_label, c("qaxis", "quantityAxisLabel")), by = "qaxis") %>%
    distinct(sc, .keep_all = TRUE)

  qty_raw  <- safe_query(rdf, sparql_qty, c("sc", "quantity")) %>%
    left_join(safe_query(rdf, sparql_notation, c("sc", "notation")), by = "sc")

  qty <- qty_raw %>%
    mutate(related_si_quantity = str_remove(as.character(quantity), "^.*/")) %>%
    transmute(notation, related_si_quantity) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(notation_sort_key(notation), related_si_quantity)

  # A service category with zero related quantities still gets a single
  # placeholder row here (related_si_quantity left blank), so it has a
  # mapping_id of its own and its confirmation_status/comment are editable
  # and persistable too -- e.g. to note "needs a quantity mapping" -- rather
  # than being permanently locked out just because there's no quantity yet.
  no_quantity_notations <- setdiff(unique(main_raw$notation), qty$notation)
  if (length(no_quantity_notations) > 0) {
    qty <- bind_rows(
      qty,
      tibble(notation = no_quantity_notations, related_si_quantity = NA_character_)
    ) %>%
      arrange(notation_sort_key(notation), related_si_quantity)
  }

  qty <- qty %>%
    mutate(
      # A single explicit join key shared by the mappings CSV and the
      # annotations CSV, rather than relying on (notation,
      # related_si_quantity) as an implicit two-column key -- simpler to
      # match on by hand (e.g. in Excel) and stays valid even if a service
      # category later gains more quantities, since each new quantity just
      # gets its own new mapping_id alongside the untouched existing ones.
      # For the no-quantity placeholder rows above, related_si_quantity is
      # blank in the key too (e.g. "M/Dens-2.3.3::"), still unique per
      # notation, and stable if a real quantity is added later (that gets
      # its own new, different mapping_id rather than reusing this one).
      mapping_id    = paste(notation, coalesce(related_si_quantity, ""), sep = "::"),
      quantity_name = vapply(coalesce(related_si_quantity, ""), quantity_name_lookup, character(1)),
      si_unit       = vapply(coalesce(related_si_quantity, ""), unit_lookup, character(1))
    ) %>%
    # unit_lookup("") resolves to "1" (its "genuinely dimensionless" case),
    # which is wrong here -- there's no quantity at all, not a dimensionless
    # one -- so blank it back out specifically for the placeholder rows.
    mutate(
      quantity_name = ifelse(is.na(related_si_quantity), NA_character_, quantity_name),
      si_unit       = ifelse(is.na(related_si_quantity), NA_character_, si_unit)
    )

  # The annotations file is the single persistent source of truth for
  # confirmation_status/comment, and is NEVER overwritten once it exists --
  # not even to append newly-appeared mappings, so a manual edit (or a
  # replaced download) is never at risk of being silently clobbered by a
  # re-render. It's only written the first time, as a starting point to edit
  # directly on disk. A mapping_id that isn't in it yet (e.g. a service
  # category just gained an additional related quantity) simply shows up
  # with default values ("unknown", "") in the live report/CSV until it's
  # added to this file -- by hand, or via the in-browser download button.
  annot_path <- path(annotations_dir, paste0(code, "_annotations.csv"))
  if (file_exists(annot_path)) {
    prior <- read_csv(annot_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(mapping_id, confirmation_status, comment)
    qty <- qty %>% left_join(prior, by = "mapping_id")
  } else {
    qty$confirmation_status <- NA_character_
    qty$comment <- NA_character_
  }
  qty <- qty %>%
    mutate(
      confirmation_status = coalesce(confirmation_status, "unknown"),
      comment              = coalesce(comment, "")
    )

  if (!file_exists(annot_path)) {
    write_csv(
      qty %>% select(mapping_id, notation, related_si_quantity, confirmation_status, comment),
      annot_path
    )
  }

  main <- main_raw %>%
    mutate(
      status = str_remove(as.character(statusURI), "^.*#"),
      individual_service = label
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      notation,
      branch        = branchLabel,
      service       = serviceLabel,
      subservice    = subserviceLabel,
      individual_service,
      section       = sectionLabel,
      medium        = mediumLabel,
      source        = sourceLabel,
      quantity_axis = quantityAxisLabel,
      status
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(notation_sort_key(notation))

  # Branch/Service/Subservice and Section/Medium/Source/QuantityAxis are two
  # mutually exclusive classification schemes (generic Consultative
  # Committees vs. RI's Section-based one -- see the Overview note). Which
  # scheme an area uses is looked up from the hardcoded area_scheme registry
  # above, not inferred from the data, so a future third scheme can't be
  # silently misclassified.
  scheme <- area_scheme[[code]]
  if (is.null(scheme)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Area '%s' has no entry in area_scheme -- add one (setup chunk) before rendering.",
      code
    ))
  }
  main <- switch(scheme,
    generic = main %>% select(-section, -medium, -source, -quantity_axis),
    section = main %>% select(-branch, -service, -subservice),
    stop(sprintf(
      "Unknown scheme '%s' for area '%s' -- add a matching case to the switch() in parse_area().",
      scheme, code
    ))
  )

  # This "mappings" CSV is fully derived from the source graphs plus
  # quantities.ttl on every render, and is always safe to overwrite --
  # confirmation_status/comment live only in the separate, never-overwritten
  # annotations CSV above; they're merged in here purely for a convenient
  # single-table view/export, not stored here.
  combined <- main %>%
    left_join(qty, by = "notation") %>%
    select(
      any_of(c(
        "mapping_id", "notation", "branch", "service", "subservice", "individual_service",
        "section", "medium", "source", "quantity_axis", "status",
        "related_si_quantity", "quantity_name", "si_unit",
        "confirmation_status", "comment"
      ))
    )

  write_csv(combined, path(output_dir, paste0(code, "_service_categories.csv")))

  real_qty <- qty %>% filter(!is.na(related_si_quantity))
  n_quantities <- nrow(real_qty)

  category_rollup <- qty %>%
    group_by(notation) %>%
    summarise(
      all_confirmed    = all(confirmation_status == "confirmed"),
      any_pending_bipm = any(confirmation_status == "pending BIPM"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      category_status = case_when(
        all_confirmed    ~ "confirmed",
        any_pending_bipm ~ "pending_BIPM",
        TRUE             ~ "pending_CC"
      )
    )

  n_categories_mapped <- length(unique(real_qty$notation))
  n_total_categories  <- nrow(category_rollup)
  n_confirmed          <- sum(category_rollup$category_status == "confirmed")
  n_pending_bipm       <- sum(category_rollup$category_status == "pending_BIPM")
  n_pending_cc         <- n_total_categories - n_confirmed - n_pending_bipm

  total_for_bar <- n_confirmed + n_pending_bipm + n_pending_cc  # == n_total_categories
  pct <- function(n) if (total_for_bar > 0) round(100 * n / total_for_bar, 1) else 0

  seg_div <- function(pct_val, bg, count, label_txt) {
    label <- if (pct_val >= 2) {
      sprintf('<span style="color:#fff; font-weight:bold;">%d&nbsp;%%</span>', round(pct_val))
    } else ""
    sprintf(
      '<div style="width: %s%%; height: 100%%; background: %s; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;" title="%d %s">%s</div>',
      pct_val, bg, count, label_txt, label
    )
  }

  progress_bar_html <- paste0(
    '<div class="progress-bar-wrap">
      <div style="display: flex; width: 100%; height: 30px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #ccc;">',
      seg_div(pct(n_confirmed),    "#a8d5b0", n_confirmed,    "confirmed"),
      seg_div(pct(n_pending_bipm), "#a9c9e8", n_pending_bipm, "pending BIPM"),
      seg_div(pct(n_pending_cc),   "#e2938f", n_pending_cc,   "pending CC"),
      '</div>
      <ul class="progress-legend">
        <li><span class="dot dot-confirmed"></span>', n_confirmed, ' individual services have been confirmed for all its quantity mappings.</li>
        <li><span class="dot dot-pending-bipm"></span>', n_pending_bipm, ' individual services are pending action from the BIPM for at least one of the quantity mappings.</li>
        <li><span class="dot dot-pending-cc"></span>', n_pending_cc, ' individual services are pending feedback or confirmation from the CC delegate, including those not yet mapped to any quantity.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>'
  )

  summary_text <- sprintf(
    "%s has **%d service categories**, of which %d have at least one quantity mapped, totalling **%d quantities** from the SI Digital Framework. At the moment of the last update (%s):",
    area_cc_label[[code]], n_total_categories, n_categories_mapped, n_quantities, Sys.Date()
  )
  
  list(code = code, title = title, combined = combined,
       summary_text = summary_text, progress_bar_html = progress_bar_html)
}

results <- map(areas, parse_area)
```

```{r editable-table-html}
#| include: false

# Builds one self-contained table per area covering every column present in
# `combined` (which varies by area_scheme -- see parse_area()). notation,
# branch/service/subservice or section/medium/source/quantity_axis,
# individual_service, status, related_si_quantity, quantity_name and si_unit
# are read-only; confirmation_status is a <select> and comment is an
# editable cell on any row with a mapping_id -- which now includes service
# categories with zero related quantities too, via the placeholder rows
# parse_area() adds for them (blank related_si_quantity, but a real,
# stable mapping_id), so there's somewhere to note e.g. "needs a quantity
# mapping" even before one exists.
#
# Column headers are clickable to sort; the search box and per-column filter
# row combine to filter rows (see the shared <script> block below). A
# "Download updated CSV file" button exports just the annotation
# columns (mapping_id, notation, related_si_quantity, confirmation_status,
# comment) from the current DOM state via a Blob download. To carry edits
# into the next render, replace annotations/<code>_annotations.csv with the
# download -- that file is never auto-overwritten by the render itself.
status_options <- c("confirmed", "pending BIPM", "pending CC")

# Per-column widths (px), the HTML equivalent of a LaTeX P{width} column
# type: a fixed width with wrapping, rather than a natural/"l"-style column
# that grows to fit its content. Anything not listed falls back to
# default_col_width. Emitted as a <colgroup> so it applies regardless of
# which columns are actually present for a given area's scheme.
col_widths <- c(
  mapping_id = 170, notation = 130, branch = 130, service = 130, subservice = 130,
  individual_service = 190, section = 110, medium = 110, source = 110,
  quantity_axis = 150, status = 90, related_si_quantity = 130,
  quantity_name = 210, si_unit = 90, confirmation_status = 150, comment = 220
)
default_col_width <- 130

opt_html <- function(selected) {
  paste0(
    map_chr(status_options, function(o) {
      sel <- if (identical(o, selected)) " selected" else ""
      paste0("<option value=\"", htmltools::htmlEscape(o), "\"", sel, ">",
             htmltools::htmlEscape(o), "</option>")
    }),
    collapse = ""
  )
}

editable_combined_table <- function(code, df) {
  cols <- names(df)
  table_id <- paste0("tbl-", code)
  cc_label <- area_cc_label[[code]]
  header_html <- paste0(
    vapply(seq_along(cols), function(i) {
      paste0("<th onclick=\"sortTable('", table_id, "',", i - 1, ")\">",
             htmltools::htmlEscape(cols[i]), "</th>")
    }, character(1)),
    collapse = ""
  )

  # One filter control per column, under the header row: a dropdown for
  # confirmation_status (fixed set of values), a plain text input everywhere
  # else. All filters (plus the global search box) combine with AND.
  filter_row_html <- paste0(
    "<tr class=\"filter-row\">",
    paste0(
      vapply(cols, function(col) {
        if (col == "confirmation_status") {
          opts <- paste0(
            "<option value=\"\"></option>",
            paste0(vapply(status_options, function(o) {
              paste0("<option value=\"", htmltools::htmlEscape(o), "\">", htmltools::htmlEscape(o), "</option>")
            }, character(1)), collapse = "")
          )
          paste0("<th><select class=\"col-filter\" oninput=\"applyAllFilters('", table_id, "')\">",
                 opts, "</select></th>")
        } else {
          paste0("<th><input type=\"text\" class=\"col-filter\" placeholder=\"filter\u2026\" ",
                 "oninput=\"applyAllFilters('", table_id, "')\"></th>")
        }
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    ),
    "</tr>"
  )

  # Soft background tint per confirmation status, applied to the whole row
  # so it's visible at a glance while scanning -- updated live via JS if the
  # dropdown is changed in-browser (see updateRowStatusClass()).
  status_row_class <- c(
    confirmed = "row-confirmed", `pending BIPM` = "row-pending-bipm", `pending CC` = "row-pending-cc"
  )

  row_html <- function(i) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    # Every row now has a mapping_id -- either a real quantity mapping or
    # the no-quantity placeholder from parse_area() -- so confirmation
    # status/comment are editable either way; only truly absent (this
    # would mean parse_area()'s placeholder logic didn't run) leaves them
    # locked, as a defensive fallback rather than the normal case.
    has_mapping_id <- "mapping_id" %in% cols && !is.na(row[["mapping_id"]])
    cells <- vapply(cols, function(col) {
      val <- row[[col]]
      val <- if (is.na(val)) "" else as.character(val)
      if (col == "confirmation_status") {
        if (has_mapping_id) {
          paste0("<td><select class=\"status-cell\" onchange=\"updateRowStatusClass(this)\">",
                 opt_html(val), "</select></td>")
        } else {
          "<td></td>"
        }
      } else if (col == "comment") {
        if (has_mapping_id) {
          paste0("<td class=\"comment-cell\" contenteditable=\"true\">", htmltools::htmlEscape(val), "</td>")
        } else {
          "<td></td>"
        }
      } else if (col == "si_unit") {
        paste0("<td class=\"unit-cell\">", htmltools::htmlEscape(val), "</td>")
      } else {
        paste0("<td>", htmltools::htmlEscape(val), "</td>")
      }
    }, character(1))
    notation_key <- htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(row[["notation"]]))
    quantity_key <- if ("related_si_quantity" %in% cols) htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(row[["related_si_quantity"]])) else ""
    row_class <- if (has_mapping_id) unname(status_row_class[row[["confirmation_status"]]]) else NA
    row_class <- if (is.na(row_class)) "" else row_class
    paste0("<tr class=\"", row_class, "\" data-notation=\"", notation_key, "\" data-quantity=\"", quantity_key, "\">",
           paste0(cells, collapse = ""), "</tr>")
  }
  rows_html <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), row_html, character(1))

  colgroup_html <- paste0(
    "<colgroup>",
    paste0(
      vapply(cols, function(col) {
        w <- unname(col_widths[col])
        if (is.na(w)) w <- default_col_width
        paste0("<col style=\"width:", w, "px\">")
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    ),
    "</colgroup>"
  )

  cols_json <- paste0("[", paste0("'", cols, "'", collapse = ","), "]")
  annotation_cols <- intersect(
    c("mapping_id", "notation", "related_si_quantity", "confirmation_status", "comment"), cols
  )
  annotation_cols_json <- paste0("[", paste0("'", annotation_cols, "'", collapse = ","), "]")

  html <- paste0(
    "<div class=\"editable-qty-wrap\">",
    "<div class=\"table-toolbar\">",
    "<button type=\"button\" class=\"dl-btn\" onclick=\"downloadAnnotationsCsv('", table_id, "', '", code, "', ",
    cols_json, ", ", annotation_cols_json, ")\">",
    "Download updated CSV file for ", cc_label, "</button>",
    "<input type=\"text\" class=\"search-box\" placeholder=\"Filter rows...\" oninput=\"applyAllFilters('", table_id, "')\">",
    "</div>",
    " <span class=\"dl-hint\">The table can be reorganized by clicking on any column header (default order by column <i>notation</i>). There is a general filter (above) and filters per each column that can be applied simultaneously. Use ",
    "<code>=empty</code> to filter the rows with a missing field.</span>",
    "<div class=\"table-scroll\">",
    "<table id=\"", table_id, "\" class=\"editable-qty-table\">",
    colgroup_html,
    "<thead><tr>", header_html, "</tr>", filter_row_html, "</thead>",
    "<tbody>", paste0(rows_html, collapse = ""), "</tbody>",
    "</table>",
    "</div></div>"
  )
  html
}
```



::: {.column-screen-inset}
**The BIPM is working with the Consultative Committees of the CIPM (CCs) to make the CMCs machine-actionable.**

The machine-actionability of the CMCs requires establishing a solid semantic link between the information in the [KCDB Appendix C](https://www.bipm.org/kcdb/cmc/advanced-search) and the knowledge model of the SI Reference Point. The first step is to relate each [KCDB service categories](https://www.bipm.org/en/cipm-mra/cipm-mra-documents/service-categories) to appropriate quantities and quantity expressions of the [SI Digital Framework](https://si-digital-framework.org/quantities). The mappings must be confirmed by experts in each CC. This webpage reports the confirmation status of these service category-to-quantity expression mappings, which are currently published as ontology graphs available in the [preproduction server](https://preprod.si-digital-framework.org/kcdb-sc) (only available for whitelisted IP addresses).

The information for each CC's Service Categories is presented in each of the tabs in the panel below. It inccludes a short summary, a progress bar, and a table with one row for each mapping pair (an individual service category may have several rows, one per quantity expression). Each pair has a confirmation status value and a field to add optional comments:

- <span class="status-badge status-confirmed">Confirmed:</span> The quantity assignment (name and units) has been <u>confirmed by the CC delegate</u>.
- <span class="status-badge status-pending-bipm">Pending BIPM:</span> An <u>action is pending from the BIPM</u> (e.g. adding/removing a quantity mapping or updating the [SI Reference Point](https://preprod.si-digital-framework.org/SI) to support new units or unit expressions).
- <span class="status-badge status-pending-cc">Pending CC:</span> Confirmation or feedback is <u>required from the CC delegate</u>.

The CC delegate is entitled to modify the confirmation status and to add comments for his/her CC. If this is the case, <u>please download the updated csv file and share it with [Cristhian Paredes](mailto:cristhian.paredes@bipm.org) for updating of this report</u>. We kindly ask you to indicate your name and organization initials in square brackets before your comment, and to separate each comment by three dashes (e.g. `[FL-NMI] comment 1. --- [CP-BIPM] reply. --- [FL-NMI] comment 2.`)

___

<!-- The columns `quantity_name` and `si_unit` are resolved from the ontology graph `quantities.ttl`. `quantity_name` is the spelled-out quantity (e.g. `DENS` is shown as `density`, and `MASS.TIME-1` as (`(mass)·(time⁻¹)`). A quantity with no units is rendered as `1` (dimensionless), and will accept values expressed as percentages. -->

:::
::: {.panel-tabset .column-screen-inset}
___

#| results: asis
walk(areas, function(code) {
  res <- results[[code]]
  cc <- area_cc_label[[code]]
  cat("\n\n## ", cc, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n**", res$title, "**\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n", res$summary_text, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n```{=html}\n", res$progress_bar_html, "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
  # cat("\n\n **Note:** If you modify a confirmation status or add a comment, please download the updated csv file and share it with [Cristhian Paredes](mailto:cristhian.paredes@bipm.org) for updating. We kindly ask you to indicate your name and organization initials in square brackets before your comment, and to separate each comment by three dashes (e.g. `[FL-NMI] comment 1. --- [CP-BIPM] reply or request. --- [FL-NMI] comment 2.`).\n\n ")
  cat("**Note:** The unit expression presented in the column `si_unit` is the default assigned to the quantity. However, other unit expressions that are dimensionally consistent will also be accepted in the CMCs of that service category (e.g. a quantity set to radians per second will also accept degrees per hour. Dimensionless quantities will accept percent values).\n\n ___ ")
  
  cat("\n\n```{=html}\n", editable_combined_table(code, res$combined), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
})
